CCU's open community charter — anyone may join via a $5 Consumers Cooperative Association fee — enables national member acquisition and amplifies the strategic value of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Data Cloud beyond geographic constraints.

narrative.scqa_md:
CCU is a $4.3B in assets credit union regulated by Illinois DFPR (state charter) + NCUA (federal insurer), operating since 1930 with 580 employees. A 15.0% multi-year growth rate gives it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-002, E-040]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 2.4/5. The deepest capability gap is Data Lifecycle & Privacy Governance at 1.7/5 against a 3.2 peer median [E-164, E-157].

Next is Natural Language Processing (NLP) at 1.7/5 against a 3.0 peer median [E-168, E-165]. Third is ESG Data Management at 2.0/5 against a 2.5 peer median [E-083]. The issue register adds Capability gap: AI Process Automation (high severity). The issue register adds Capability gap: Model Serving & Continuous Monitoring (high severity).

The roster shows no CISO — a named ownership gap for the capabilities below. The question for CCU is whether to close Data Lifecycle & Privacy Governance first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. CCU should lead with Tableau (71/100 fit) against Enterprise Data Catalog & Discovery, then sequence nCino behind it. Closing Data Lifecycle & Privacy Governance to the peer median alone is worth 1.5 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.

The analyst's own priority framing: "Creatio deployed 2024 via Technology Advisors Inc.; 15-system consolidation; 45K cases/year; mortgage 6 days → 1 hour [E-173]…".
